name: Infisical CLI
description: The Infisical command-line tool, installed on this computer.

spec.summary: The Infisical CLI on this computer. Scripts use it only to sign in; secrets travel over the REST API.

instructions.*: Install the Infisical CLI from https://infisical.com/docs/cli/overview, open a new terminal so it is on your `PATH`, and press **Check**.
instructions.darwin:
With Homebrew:

```sh
brew install infisical/get-cli/infisical
```

Then press **Check**. (Without Homebrew, see https://infisical.com/docs/cli/overview.)
instructions.linux:
Debian and Ubuntu:

```sh
curl -1sLf 'https://artifacts-cli.infisical.com/setup.deb.sh' | sudo -E bash
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y infisical
```

Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE, Alpine and Arch have their own package in https://infisical.com/docs/cli/overview. With Homebrew on Linux: `brew install infisical/get-cli/infisical`.

Open a new terminal if `infisical --version` is not found, then press **Check**.
instructions.windows:
With Scoop:

```powershell
scoop bucket add org https://github.com/Infisical/scoop-infisical.git
scoop install infisical
```

or with winget: `winget install infisical`. Open a new terminal and press **Check**.
